# Copilot instructions

This repository keeps one set of instructions for every AI agent and every human:
[`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md). Read it first and follow it; it wins over anything else.

- **Procedures** are Agent Skills in [`.agents/skills/`](../.agents/skills/): the change
  workflow, stacked PRs, self-review, visual design review, and PR review.
- **Facts** about the system are in [`docs/project.md`](../docs/project.md) and
  [`docs/architecture/`](../docs/architecture/README.md).
- **Conventions** by topic are in [`docs/guidelines/`](../docs/guidelines/README.md).

This file is a thin adapter. Don't add rules here; change `AGENTS.md`, `docs/` or
`.agents/skills/` instead.
